# TPC-DS-OBT Q26

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT item_i_item_id, AVG(quantity) AS agg1, AVG(list_price) AS agg2, AVG(coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(sales_price) AS agg4 FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND item_sk = item_i_item_sk AND bill_cdemo_sk = bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk AND promo_sk = promo_p_promo_sk AND bill_cdemo_cd_gender = '0' AND bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '0' AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = '0' AND (promo_p_channel_email = 'N' OR promo_p_channel_event = 'N') AND sold_date_d_year = 1998) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY item_i_item_id ORDER BY item_i_item_id LIMIT 100
```
